verdict.rationale: Linear is a planning and issue-tracking tool, so a scope-approval gate before work starts is a fair axis. The pack shows no such workflow. "Diffs" and "Merge approved changes" cover code review after work exists, and agent delegation and customer-request editing are adjacent features, not a pre-work scope approval step.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it
